events.title: Status Update March 19th
events.summary: Updates Since Our Last PlaytestWe have begun work on our next round of updates since our last playtest. Our goal is to create a polished, playable demo with our three levels and three game modes with both local and online play modes available where anyone can jump on and play locally or with a group of friends to enjoy Rodent Rampage. events.title: Second Beta Playtest
events.summary: The next Beta playtest for Rodent Rampage will be Saturday, February 7 from 5pm to midnight EST.We've made a bunch of updates to the game, including a new level: The Playroom!Don't forget to request Playtest access and invite your friends. See you then!

events.title: First Beta Playtest
events.summary: The first Beta playtest for Rodent Rampage will be this Saturday, January 17 from 5pm to midnight EST. Don't forget to request Playtest access and invite your friends. See you then!

events.title: Rodent Rampage Steam Page Live!
events.summary: We've just published the Rodent Rampage Steam Page and are accepting Playtest/Beta requests! We're getting close to an Early Access release where we'll get valuable community feedback to make Rodent Rampage the best it can be. First though, we plan to hold Beta playtest events where players can play matches with friends or match up with other players in the matchmaking queue.
